007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Credential;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.CredentialConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for creating a {@link Credential} object from {@link SelectAI}.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
021 * {@link CredentialConfig}, and call {@link SelectAI#credential(CredentialConfig)}.
022 * It does not call {@link Credential#create()}.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
025 * <ul>
026 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
030 * </ul>
031 *
032 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
033 * <ul>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD</li>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_USER_OCID</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_TENANCY_OCID</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_PRIVATE_KEY</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_FINGERPRINT</li>
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
045 * }</pre>
046 *
047 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
048 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
049 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * mvn clean install
052 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>Compile and run this sample:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" -d samples/out samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/selectai/CreateCredentialObjectSample.java
058 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.selectai.CreateCredentialObjectSample
059 * }</pre>
060 *
061 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
062 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
063 * and diagnostics.</p>
064 */
065public final class CreateCredentialObjectSample {
066    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateCredentialObjectSample.class);
067
068    private CreateCredentialObjectSample() {
069    }
070
071    public static void main(String[] args) {
072        try {
073            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
074            CredentialConfig credentialConfig = buildCredentialConfig();
075            Credential credential = selectAI.credential(credentialConfig);
076
077            System.out.printf("Credential object created for '%s'.%n", credentialConfig.getCredentialName());
078            System.out.printf("Credential implementation: %s%n", credential.getClass().getName());
079        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
080            LOGGER.error("Failed to create Select AI client for credential object sample.", e);
081        }
082    }
083
084    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
085        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
086                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
087                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
088                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
089                .build();
090
091        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
092    }
093
094    private static CredentialConfig buildCredentialConfig() {
095        CredentialConfig.Builder builder = CredentialConfig.builder(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME"));
096        applyOptionalString(builder::username, "SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_USERNAME");
097        applyOptionalString(builder::password, "SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD");
098        applyOptionalString(builder::userOcid, "SELECTAI_USER_OCID");
099        applyOptionalString(builder::tenancyOcid, "SELECTAI_TENANCY_OCID");
100        applyOptionalString(builder::privateKey, "SELECTAI_PRIVATE_KEY");
101        applyOptionalString(builder::fingerprint, "SELECTAI_FINGERPRINT");
102        return builder.build();
103    }
104
105    private static void applyOptionalString(StringAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
106        String value = System.getenv(envName);
107        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
108            setter.set(value);
109        }
110    }
111
112    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
113        String value = System.getenv(name);
114        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
115            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
116        }
117        return value;
118    }
119
120    @FunctionalInterface
121    private interface StringAttributeSetter {
122        void set(String value);
123    }
124}
